title: Choose pod-god's visual world — second hand
question: Keep Producer's Score, take a challenger, or ask for one final fresh roll.

options.label: Producer's Score
options.lineage: conductor scores, rehearsal marks, and production cue notation
options.thesis: The conversation is the lead stave; every production stage joins it as a synchronized track.
options.viewport: A broad conversation stave leads the center while quieter tracks expose hosts, format, episodes, scripts, and audio around one moving cue.
options.risk: Musical notation can feel precious unless its tracks map directly to production artifacts and controls.

options.label: Studio Wayfinding
options.thesis: The app becomes a chain of unmistakable production decisions, each sign showing only the next useful move.
options.case: Best next-step clarity, but the journey metaphor identifies transit more strongly than podcast creation.
options.viewport: Chat leads under one monumental amber destination band; completed stages recede and the next production decision stays fixed.
options.risk: Full-field amber can overwhelm long conversations and make creative work feel procedural.

options.label: One-Bit Production Desktop
options.thesis: Chat is the desk, and specialist production tools open as crisp task windows only when summoned.
options.case: Excellent progressive disclosure and pixel character, but overlapping windows can recreate the current cognitive load.
options.viewport: A dominant chat window sits on a sparse desktop while one contextual production window opens beside it and the rest stay as icons.
options.risk: Retro desktop conventions can become a costume and complicate responsive behavior.

options.label: Production Cue Horizon
options.lineage: stage-light cue plots and cyclorama transitions
options.thesis: The studio moves from blackout to finished show through named cue bands whose light reveals each production surface.
options.case: A strong production arc and completion moment, but atmosphere is weaker than a score for dense editing clarity.
options.viewport: Chat occupies the active illuminated band while setup, scripts, and audio appear as darker named cues before and after it.
options.risk: Replacing the source's dawn colors with the pinned palette can flatten the light-based identity.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar AI workspace with chat beside a conventional production dashboard, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A chat column leads, with a step navigator and contextual production form beside it.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable, but visually interchangeable with other AI workflow products.
